title: 153 pet owners file complaints vs. Bacoor crematorium over dumped animal remains

blocks.text: A total of 153 pet owners have formally filed complaints with the Bacoor City Police Station in connection with the alleged improper disposal of their deceased pets and possible consumer fraud involving a pet crematorium, police said Tuesday.
